arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Smith asserted the LIA does not cover broader regulatory authority.
Ms. Harrington urged the Court to separate field and conflict preemption.
Mr. Frederick stated Congress intended the LIA for locomotive safety in use.
Mr. Hacker argued the DOT holds exclusive authority over locomotive design.
